00202 /* FLAGS
00203  * These are the flags that define how the profile is opened.  Broken down
00204  * as follows:
00205  * - BIT 1: Defines whether profile is acting as SERVER or CLIENT
00206  * - BIT 2 - 4: Exclusive, defines security level, a change here
00207  *              changes security of whole system, if other connections are
00208  *              active and have different security level, security won't change
00209  * - BIT 5 - 8: Exclusive, defines how IO works
00210  * - BIT 9 - 16: Currently undefined
00211  * - BIT 17 - 32: Exclusive, defines profile being used
00212  */
00213 
00214 /* Connection Type */
00215 
00216 #define CON_SERVER 0
00217 #define CON_CLIENT 1
00218 
00219 #define F_CON_OFFSET 0
00220 #define F_CON_MSK    1
00221 
00222 #define F_CON(x)    ((x) << F_CON_OFFSET)
00223 #define GET_CON(x)  (((x) >> F_CON_OFFSET) & F_CON_MSK)
00224 
00225 /* Security level */
00226 
00227 #define SEC_DONT_CHANGE 0
00228 #define SEC_L1          1
00229 #define SEC L2          2
00230 #define SEC_L3          3
00231 #define SEC_NONE        4
00232 
00233 #define F_SEC_OFFSET    1
00234 #define F_SEC_MSK       0x7
00235 
00236 #define F_SEC(x)   ((x) << F_SEC_OFFSET)
00237 #define GET_SEC(x) (((x) >> F_SEC_OFFSET) & F_SEC_MSK)
00238 
00239 /* IO setup */
00240 
00241 #define IO_NO_WAIT_ON_OPEN 0x0
00242 #define IO_WAIT_ON_OPEN    0x1
00243 
00244 #define F_IO_OFFSET        4
00245 #define F_IO_MSK           0xF
00246 
00247 #define F_IO(x)    ((x) << F_IO_OFFSET)
00248 #define GET_IO(x)  ((uint8_t) (((x) >> F_IO_OFFSET) & F_IO_MSK))
00249

00543 /* BtWriteCompletionFn_t */
00544 /**
00545     @brief Write completion routine.  Called when a packet submitted via
00546     HxBtWrite has been completed by the profile/protocol handler.
00547 
00548     If Write returns a failure, then the completion routine will not be called.
00549     If the Write routine returns success or pending, the completion routine will
00550     be called.  In the case of pending, the completion routine may be called at a
00551     later time.
00552 
00553     @param  conn    IN  connection handle for profile
00554     @param  err     IN  Error code for write
00555 *******************************************************************************/
00556 
00557 typedef void    (*BtWriteCompletionFn_t)(BtConn_t conn, BtErr_t err );
